name: data
description: Data repo: Spark ETL/ELT job with declarative quality checks, plus the Liquibase schema migrations it depends on.

variables.name: PIPELINE_NAME
variables.description: Pipeline name in kebab-case. Becomes the repo, job name, and S3 code prefix.

variables.name: OWNER
variables.description: Backstage group name of the team owning reruns, backfills, and failed checks.

variables.name: REPOSITORY
variables.description: Repository the scaffold lands in, as owner/name.

variables.name: AWS_REGION
variables.description: Region the pipeline and database live in.

variables.name: TOOLKIT_REF
variables.description: Published toolkit release tag or full commit SHA. No floating branches.

variables.name: REPOSITORY_BASE_URL
variables.description: Git hosting base URL for source links. Delivery workflows currently target GitHub.
